verdict.rationale: Moneybird's own llms.txt names a first-party CLI as one of three channels on its REST API, so an official CLI is claimed. Beyond that single line there is no documentation of the CLI's installation, commands, authentication flow, or agent-oriented features, and no hands-on corroboration. Missing for 10: CLI documentation (install, command reference, auth), evidence of AI-native or agent workflows in the CLI, independent or hands-on verification.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Three channels on the same REST API: MCP for an AI chat, the CLI for the terminal, the API for your own software.
